declarations.name: traitsFromSeed
declarations.description:
The traits a seed (usually a username) produces. Pure apart from the
walking leg pose, which is picked at random as it always has been, so it
can be used by tools (like rpg-character-builder) that need a seed's look
without rendering a character.

members.name: toCode
members.description:
The code for the character as currently shown: seed-derived traits plus
every explicit choice. Setting it back on any rpg-character (the code
attribute) recreates this exact character.

members.name: _slot
members.description:
Effective value of a string or boolean slot: an explicit attribute wins,
then the character code, otherwise "none" (false for boolean slots).

members.name: _gear
members.description: Gear slots also fall back to the (effective) preset's defaults.

members.name: _season
members.description:
The season this character is dressing up for, or null. Only when
seasonal is on; seasonal-date (YYYY-MM-DD) previews another day.

members.name: _preset
members.description:
Effective preset: an explicit or coded preset wins; otherwise the
seasonal costume, if any. Seasonal costumes are never written into the
code, so a saved character is not stuck in October.

members.name: renderClippedPiece
members.description:
A layer with the lowered arm(s) of a pose clipped out. Drawn in the
113x142 art space (like the flag text) so the clip lines up with the art
at any width / height.

members.name: renderCells
members.description: Expression / pose cells, colored to match the character's skin.

members.name: renderFlagText
members.description:
Short text on the pennant of the flag item (e.g. a team or school
abbreviation). Drawn in the 113x142 art space so it scales with the
character the same way every image layer does.

`rpg-character-builder`

declarations.name: encodeCharacter
declarations.description:
Encode a character description (an object with any of the slot names, plus
an optional flagText) into a code. Unknown or missing values encode as the
slot default.

declarations.name: decodeCharacter
declarations.description:
Decode a code into a full character description: every slot gets a value
(its default when the code is shorter or the index is unknown) plus
flagText. Returns null for anything that is not a code of a known version.

declarations.name: easterSunday
declarations.description:
Easter Sunday (Western) for a year: the anonymous Gregorian algorithm.
Returns [month (1-12), day].

declarations.name: seasonFor
declarations.description:
The season for a date, or null outside every season. A season is
{ name, preset: [...] } or { name, hat: [...] }.

declarations.name: seasonalPick
declarations.description: Pick one of a season's options from a seed, stably.
